name: adcm-toolkits
description: Public ADCM toolkits: the Council multi-advisor deliberation framework (generic, bring-your-own-context), a code-project context generator that builds a lazy-loading, refreshable knowledge base of a codebase (architecture, API surface, data models, config, security, conventions), and an execution-prompt architect that turns goals + deep code analysis into a six-document execution plan (executive proposal, master plan, detailed plan, timeframe plan with critical path and week-by-week schedule, task tracker, execution protocol) with copy-paste prompts per wave and an optional single-file HTML with a CSS Gantt timeline. Use for structured multi-perspective decisions, to document a codebase, or to plan and prompt large tasks and migrations.
